name: bellsprout
description: Connect Edworking projects, tasks, conversations and files to your assistant.

interface.longDescription: Read accessible projects, tasks, conversations and file information. Create tasks and projects, edit task names and deadlines, send messages and import public files when requested and authorized. Search covers up to 500 recently updated task titles; document bodies, status changes and reassignment are not supported. Requires an Edworking account and browser authorization with a dedicated scoped token.
defaultPrompt: Show the tasks in my launch project.
Create a task to review the proposal, due Friday.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only projects accessible in the connected demo workspace, with links and pagination.

positive.prompt: Show tasks in Launch with their deadlines.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the project ID, then list its task names, deadlines, statuses and source links.
Return matching titles and source links, explicitly disclosing bounded search coverage.

positive.prompt: Create a task called Review the proposal in Launch, due 2026-11-06 at 17:00 UTC.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one task with the requested fields. Preserve requestId across retries.

positive.description: Read and send a requested message
positive.prompt: Read Demo planning, then send exactly: The review is complete.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the unique destination, read accessible history, then send the exact requested text once. Clarify ambiguous destinations.

negative.prompt: Send that message to the team.
